notes: results text: relative change in liver fat by MRI-PDFF at week 48, estimated treatment ratio 0.67 (0.51 to 0.88), p 0.0042; baseline MRI-PDFF 10.0 percent (CV 58.3) and 10.4 percent (CV 54.7), lower than in non cirrhotic NASH as expected at this disease stage | STUDY: randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 2 trial of once weekly semaglutide escalated to 2.4 mg versus matching placebo for 48 weeks in biopsy confirmed NASH related cirrhosis with BMI 27 or above (NCT03987451), randomised 2:1 and stratified by diabetes status, 47 versus 24 patients, 64 of 71 completing treatment.
